name: Asahi Kasei Plastics North America
old_description: Introducing Asahi Kasei's engineering plastic products, their features, and examples of applications in a variety of fields.
about:
Asahi Kasei Plastics North America operates from Fowlerville, Michigan, as the North American subsidiary of Japan's Asahi Kasei Corporation, serving as the regional hub for the group's engineering plastics business.

The portfolio centers on high-performance engineering plastics: polyamide (LEONA™), polyacetal (TENAC™), modified PPE (XYRON™), polypropylene compounds, and advanced materials such as engineering particle foams, continuous glass- and carbon-fiber reinforced thermoplastics, cellulose nanofiber nanocomposites, and purging compounds (ASACLEAN®). The company also provides CAE analysis—including topology optimization and structural simulation—molding guidance, extrusion grade recommendations, and binder proposals for powder injection molding, supporting customers from product design through mass production.

Customers span AI data centers, automotive, solar energy, electrical/electronic, and medical device sectors. For AI infrastructure, grades address power connectors, intelligent PDUs, battery backup units, server fans, and cooling pumps. Automotive applications include millimeter-wave radar antennas requiring high dimensional stability and plating performance, plus in-vehicle battery peripherals. Solar products cover photovoltaic connectors and junction boxes with weather resistance. Medical-grade POM resins meet ISO 10993-5 and USP Class VI biocompatibility standards.

Asahi Kasei emphasizes customized solutions backed by resin expertise and CAE-driven design optimization, alongside carbon neutrality and circular economy initiatives. In 2026, the North American operation received DENSO's North America Business Partner Award, reflecting its collaborative approach with major automotive suppliers.

name: Ascend Medical LLC
old_description: Ascend Medical was founded in 2014 with a goal to help the Treasure Valley have access to more orthopedic, sport bracing, and post op recovery resources. We are have expanded our company to work alongside physicians in Idaho and Utah.
about:
Ascend Medical LLC was founded in 2014 in Boise, Idaho, with the goal of expanding access to orthopedic bracing, sports bracing, and post-operative recovery resources for the Treasure Valley region. The company does not publicly name its founders or ownership structure.

The firm supplies orthopedic bracing, sport bracing, post-operative recovery products, wound-care items, and biologics to patients and physicians across Idaho and Utah. It operates a facility on West Emerald Street in Boise and collaborates directly with healthcare providers, including Veterans Affairs communities, to deliver products and patient-focused services. Headcount, facility size, and order volumes are not disclosed.

Ascend Medical serves patients, orthopedic and sports-medicine physicians, and VA healthcare networks in Idaho and Utah. Its product lines address orthopedics, sports injuries, post-surgical recovery, wound management, and biologic therapies.

The company states its founding mission was to fill a gap in local access to advanced recovery products, and it emphasizes that patient care remains its top priority.

name: Aspen Electronics Manufacturing Inc.
old_description: Many companies claim it, yet we live by it. At each stage of product delivery, we stand by our word.
about:
Aspen Electronics Manufacturing Inc. operates from Westminster, Colorado. The company has grown responsibly for 26 consecutive years, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founders are not specified in available sources.

The shop provides printed circuit board assembly services spanning surface-mount and through-hole technologies, component sourcing, prototyping, and functional testing. Capabilities include hand placement of leaded and surface-mount parts, automated fine-pitch and BGA placement, in-circuit test, full unit build, cable and harness assembly, and automated optical inspection (AOI) with optical character recognition on all SMT components. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Aspen Electronics serves customers requiring ITAR-compliant manufacturing, as evidenced by its registration with the U.S. Department of Defense. The company's engineering-driven approach puts customers in direct contact with a manager who has an engineering background, eliminating internal translation of technical requirements.

The company emphasizes a lean manufacturing system integrated across all processes, targeting a defect rate near zero through thorough functional testing. It promotes fair pricing supported by supplier relationships and commits to on-time delivery, with staff often working overtime to meet deadlines.

name: Assembled Products, Inc.
old_description: Specializing in Prototypes, Small to Medium Production Electronics Assembly  and Manufacutring since 1986
about:
Assembled Products, Inc. is based in Rogersville, Alabama, in the Elgin community north of the city. The company was founded in January 1986 by Michael Stevens, who left a larger manufacturer that declined small jobs. Stevens started the business in a former cabinet shop in Collierville, Tennessee, before moving to Piperton, Tennessee in 1990 and later to a 33,000‑square‑foot facility in Elgin, Alabama. The firm is woman‑owned and operates as a small business.

The company provides printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) and electromechanical assembly services, including surface‑mount, through‑hole, and mixed‑technology soldering (both leaded and RoHS‑compliant lead‑free). It handles box‑build and complete system integration, wire‑harness assembly, conformal coating, functional testing, and repair/rework. Additional capabilities encompass design‑for‑manufacturability review, 3D printing, CAD documentation, patent research, and new‑product consulting. The 33,000‑square‑foot Alabama facility supports prototype through medium‑volume runs with a staff of approximately 10.

Customers span defense, automotive, education, logistics, and general industrial sectors. Named clients have included Federal Express, the University of Memphis, AutoZone, Hypertech, and IBS, alongside individual inventors and hobbyists. The company also serves military electronics upgrade programs and custom electronics projects for clients across Tennessee, Mississippi, Georgia, Florida, and nationally.

Assembled Products emphasizes its woman‑owned, small‑business structure as a source of responsiveness and communication speed. It promotes Alabama’s low labor and tax rates as a cost advantage while maintaining a quality‑first philosophy, stating it will not sacrifice reliability for low‑cost offshore alternatives.

old_description: , we’ve delivered fast turnaround, cost-effective solutions, and reliable results.
about:
Assembly Solutions is headquartered in Bridgeton, Missouri. The company was founded in 2001 by four entrepreneurs in an incubator facility in St. Charles, Missouri, recognizing the growing demand for reliable contract manufacturing.

The company provides full-service electronic contract manufacturing, including printed circuit board assemblies (through-hole and surface-mount), cable and harness assemblies, electromechanical box builds, comprehensive testing, and engineering design services. Its integrated facility handles projects ranging from small custom runs to high-volume production, supported by a senior team with over 40 years of combined expertise in materials management, production control, quality assurance, and engineering.

Assembly Solutions serves original equipment manufacturers across agriculture, aviation, construction and mining, general manufacturing, medical, LED lighting and chargers, video and surveillance, and industrial controls. The company emphasizes turnkey solutions from concept to finished product, reducing time to market for OEM customers.

The company differentiates itself through its one-stop manufacturing model, consolidating PCB assembly, cable harness, box build, testing, and design under one roof. The founders started the business to address the need for dependable, scalable electronic manufacturing in the region.

name: Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc.
old_description: Astro is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas.
about:
Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc. is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas. The business, now headquartered in Grand Prairie, has operated for over five decades under continuous family ownership. The founders are not named in public materials.

The company provides architectural and industrial metal solutions. Its architectural metalwork scope covers design assistance, submittal drawings, mockups, fabrication, and installation, including custom brake metal forming up to 14 feet long and fabrication for subcontractors in glazing, millwork, drywall, and waterproofing. For general contractors, Astro delivers architectural metal packages in a range of finishes for bar areas, ceilings, elevator entries, and reception areas. On the industrial side, the shop serves food service and plant maintenance sectors with project consulting, custom fittings, hoppers, platforms, and transitions. Rush delivery is offered throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin metro areas.

Astro works with designers, builders, and contractors across commercial construction, healthcare, hospitality, retail, entertainment, education, and office development. Representative projects include architectural metalwork for the Amon Carter Museum in Fort Worth, the Bowie House Hotel, the OU Medical Center in Oklahoma City, the AMLI Fountain Place tower in Dallas, the Meow Wolf installation in Grapevine, and the College Station City Hall. The company also supports food service and plant maintenance clients with custom metal components.

Astro emphasizes a commitment to excellence, rapid turnaround times, and exceptional customer service as the foundation of its reputation. The firm positions itself as a partner that gives architects and builders the freedom to turn bold ideas into enduring structures, combining precision, artistry, and integrity in every cut, bend, and weld.

name: Atelier Amelia
old_description: Atelier Amelia is a New York-based garment manufacturer providing full-service support to established and emerging designer labels. Our team of experts offers comprehensive solutions, including sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, production, and fitting services. We understand that each client is unique, and we work with them to create a customized approach that meets their specific needs and requirements.
about:
Atelier Amelia is a garment manufacturer based in New York, New York, founded in 2016 by designer Zhu Ru Chen. After struggling to find reliable manufacturers for her own swimwear line, Chen established the company to provide high-quality production with a personal touch for emerging brands.

The company operates a full-service sample room and production factory, offering sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, garment production, and fitting services. Its in-house facility can accommodate 3,000 to 5,000 pieces per month, handling both small production runs and flexible quantities while maintaining quality.

Atelier Amelia serves established and emerging designer labels in the fashion and apparel industry. Clients include brands like Maiden Name, whose co-founder Alix Freireich has worked with the company since 2019. The firm focuses on supporting up-and-coming designers and young creative talent producing in the USA.

The company emphasizes Made-in-NY manufacturing, passion for client success, and future adoption of 3D fitting technology to reduce cost and time. It was started to solve the founder's own difficulty in finding reliable production partners.
